notes: The two the-tokens of the name of the man are counted under rule 29's arthrous case: nothing is fronted, the article takes the the standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
The of in of his two sons goes to the immediate rectum shene (rule 19); the competing reading putting it on banaw is named in the unit note.
haya of s029 is rendered by the lexical verb continued and takes it, so rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause does not arise.
